_Copenhagen, Denmark

_**About The Job

**Do you want to work with data engineering, platform development, and data-based automated processes within Saxo's Financial Crime Prevention (FCP)? Saxo is an investment bank with high speed, global colleagues, and a strong focus on using technology and data to prevent financial crime. We are looking for a Senior Software/Data Engineer to join the FCP Modelling & Development team.

FCP Modelling & Development is part of the 1st Line of Defence in Group Operations and is located in Saxo's headquarters in Hellerup. The team works with models and data-based automated processes used across FCP. The goal is to ensure that these data assets and processes are sound, fit for purpose, adequately documented, secure, and regularly reviewed.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build, operate, and continuously improve reusable AML data products, data-modelling components, and user-facing interfaces, with clear ownership, lineage, documentation, quality controls, and production reliability.

• Design robust ETL pipelines and integration interfaces for operational, analytical, model-development, and external-platform use cases, enabling secure and efficient data exchange across internal and external systems.

• Translate FCP and AML requirements into durable, adaptable production systems, contributing to solution architecture decisions on design patterns, system scalability, regulatory compliance, and flexibility across AML processes.

• Partner with FCP and AML subject-matter experts on transaction monitoring, customer segmentation, scenario development, client risk rating, surveillance support, and AML-related development initiatives that strengthen financial crime prevention capabilities.

• Define automated checks for completeness, consistency, validity, reconciliation, source-to-target integrity, architectural integrity, security, performance, and governance standards.

• Own observability, alerting, incident response, backfills, runbooks, performance tuning, production support, and operational resilience for critical data assets.

• Raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, mentoring, reusable patterns, clean and well-documented code, test-driven development, secure coding practices, CI/CD pipeline optimization, automated testing, and continuous improvement.

**Your profile

**

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data-platform engineering, or a related production data role.

• Strong Python, SQL, and Spark skills, with experience building and maintaining production data pipelines and data models.

• Practical experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow, Azure, or similar technologies.

• Experience supporting ML workflows, including feature engineering, feature data preparation, dataset versioning, reproducible training and validation datasets, model-validation support, and production-ready model inputs.

• Deployment skills for production workloads, including CI/CD, containerized services, and Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms.

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, data access controls, encryption, secure handling of sensitive data, and practical data-security patterns using Azure services such as Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Azure RBAC, and Managed Identities.

• Hands-on experience maintaining production data pipelines, including data quality testing, reconciliation, lineage, metadata management, documentation, monitoring, and operational controls.

• Experience with financial crime prevention in regulated financial services, including AML, KYC/CDD/ODD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, client risk rating, and market-abuse surveillance support.

• Experience with GDPR-sensitive data, audit evidence, regulator-facing reporting, or data governance in control-heavy environments

**Nice To Have

**

• Experience with data quality validation tools e.g. Great Expectations (GX), dbt‑expectations, Soda, Deequ, or Microsoft Fabric.

• Clear communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

About the role

Sparrow Quantum is growing fast, and the people we hire in the coming years will shape what the company becomes. We are looking for a talent acquisition and HR partner who can lead our recruiting efforts and grow with our HR function.

Recruitment is the core of the role. You will own hiring from the first conversation with a hiring manager to the signed contract, across scientific, engineering, and commercial roles, in Denmark and internationally. Some travel might be expected.

Initially, your focus will be on talent acquisition. Once core hiring is under way, you will gradually take on more of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding, with support from external HR partners. HR at Sparrow Quantum is a function under development, and the role will grow with it, with a path towards Head of HR.

Responsibilities

Core responsibilities - leading talent acquisition

• 
Own the full recruitment process, from role definition with hiring managers to offer and contract-signing

• 
Source and attract candidates for specialist roles in quantum photonics, engineering, and production, as well as business functions

• 
Work with our Communications & Marketing Manager on building our employer brand and a talent pipeline, including attending job fairs at local and international universities

• 
Own our applicant tracking system, and report on hiring progress and time to hire

• 
Manage recruitment agencies, where they add value

• 
Coordinate with our Office & Admin Manager on work permits and relocation for international hires

• 
Source scientists and engineers through academic networks, conferences, and research groups, and run technical screening together with hiring managers

Career growth - HR across the employee life cycle

• 
Design onboarding that integrates new colleagues quickly

• 
Own retention initiatives, including employee surveys and follow-up on the results

• 
Support on building performance reviews and development paths for our employees

• 
Run offboarding, including exit interviews and knowledge handover

• 
Be the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions

• 
Keep contracts, policies, and HR documentation compliant with Danish employment law

Building the function

• 
Prioritize which HR processes, policies, and tools to build first as the company scales

• 
Manage our collaboration with external HR partners

• 
Advise management on workforce planning, organization ,and compensation, together with the VP of Finance

Who we are looking for

You are an HR professional with a strong recruitment profile, and you want to grow into or take on a broader HR role. If you don't already have experience within quantum or deep tech, then you should have a keen eye and an ability to learn quickly, so you can help find the best candidates for our team. And you should be excited by the prospect of being part of a company that's on a growth journey, where each day is often different from the next.

Must-haves

• 
2 to 6 years of experience in HR, with a clear focus on recruitment

• 
A clear wish to broaden into HR, from onboarding and development to offboarding

• 
Working knowledge of Danish employment law and practice

• 
A structured way of working and sound judgement with confidential matters

• 
Fluent written and spoken English

Nice-to-haves

• 
Experience within deep tech, research, or tech, and at a start-up or scale-up

• 
Experience recruiting scientists or engineers, ideally internationally

• 
Experience working with Teamtailor and its HRIS Aboard

• 
Experience setting up HR processes or an applicant tracking system from scratch

• 
Experience with work permits for non-EU hires

• 
Experience working with external HR or recruitment partners

What we offer

• 
Working in a highly motivated team of passionate people at the forefront of photonic quantum technology

• 
Competitive salary + company paid pension

• 
DSB Business Card

• 
Private health insurance

• 
Flexible working hours and ability to work remotely temporarily

• 
Six weeks of paid vacation and paid family leave

• 
Lunch subsidized by the company

• 
Company phone and company credit card

• 
Opportunities to attend conferences and workshops

• 
Steep learning curve in a supportive environment within a rapidly expanding industry

Why Sparrow

• 
Passionate International Team – Join a group of committed professionals where your perspective and initiative have a direct impact

• 
Cutting-Edge Projects and Collaborators – Work with world-leading researchers and innovators to shape quantum technology's future

• 
Growth and Learning – Be part of a supportive culture with mentoring, knowledge sharing, and opportunities to evolve your role

• 
Career Progression – Grow into project leadership, operations, or funding strategy based on your strengths

• 
Inclusive Culture – We value diversity and prioritize employee well-being and flexibility

How to apply

Scroll down to submit your CV and a short cover letter in English.

We review applications as they arrive and may close the position early, so apply soon. The final deadline is December 1, 2026. For questions about the role, contact Andreas Olesen ao@sparrowquantum.com .

We are committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities.

About Sparrow Quantum

Sparrow Quantum is a Danish quantum technology company advancing light-matter interfaces for quantum technologies and is widely recognized as a leader in single-photon sources.

Our first product is an on-chip single-photon source that delivers more than 20 million high-quality single photons per second into an optical fiber, used by customers for applications such as multi-photon quantum simulation and quantum key distribution.

The patented technology builds on more than two decades of research by founder Peter Lodahl and the Hy-Q Center of Excellence at the Niels Bohr Institute in Copenhagen. Learn more at www.sparrowquantum.com.

Are you a strong leadership profile who can translate strategy into action plans, then you have the chance to become the Managing Director of Form & Frys.

Drive strategy, performance, and operational excellence across the organization

As Managing Director of Form & Frys, you will have full P&L responsibility and overall accountability for the strategic, commercial, operational, and organizational development of the company. Reporting to the Board of Directors of Rademaker, you will lead the business into its next phase of development, with a clear mandate to drive profitable growth, strengthen performance, and build a more scalable organization.

You will own the financial performance of the business, including revenue, profitability, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery against agreed targets and KPIs. Working closely with the leadership team, you will translate strategy into clear priorities and strengthen structures, processes, and leadership capabilities across sales, engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, finance, and people.

Commercially, you will strengthen relationships with key customers and strategic accounts while identifying new opportunities for growth. At the same time, you will work closely with Rademaker to leverage the capabilities and international reach of the wider organization, balancing Form & Frys’ entrepreneurial mindset, technical expertise, and customer proximity with the structure and strategic direction required for continued profitable growth.

Adept leader with technical abilities and a strong commercial mindset

The ideal candidate brings solid senior leadership experience from an international industrial or manufacturing environment, ideally within machinery, automation, food processing equipment, or another engineering-driven business. You have held full P&L responsibility and combine strong commercial acumen with a sound understanding of operations, technology, and financial management that enables you to make informed decisions that drive the company’s performance. Likewise, you have extensive experience in managing high-level, global stakeholders, paired with strong technical expertise.

You have a proven track record of developing and professionalizing organizations, translating strategy into execution, and driving profitable growth. Experience working with a parent company or professional Board is an advantage, as is exposure to international B2B markets.

You are a commercially minded and engaging leader who combines strategic perspective with a pragmatic, hands-on approach. You create direction, structure, and accountability while empowering the organization and leadership team to take ownership and deliver results. Entrepreneurial and decisive by nature, you are comfortable operating close to customers, employees, and the business while maintaining a broader strategic perspective. You build strong relationships across the organization and balance the need for greater structure and professionalization with the agility and entrepreneurial mindset that characterize Form & Frys. Furthermore, you are required to possess strong interpersonal and communication skills, as you will be collaborating across various functions and levels within the organization. Finally, fluency in both Danish and English is required, and you should be prepared to travel as necessary to meet the demands of this role.

Set and execute the strategic direction at Form & Frys

This is a unique opportunity to become part of a global organization, where management and professionalism are of the highest standards within the food processing industry. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search (www.venaris.dk). For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant Lars Nordlund on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Form & Frys Maskinteknik

Form & Frys is a Danish engineering company specializing in the development and manufacture of advanced machinery for the international bakery industry. Based in Hobro, Denmark, the company provides specialized solutions for forming, folding, and filling dough-based products, including Danish and puff pastry, pizza, pies, and savoury products. Combining strong technical expertise, application know-how, and close customer collaboration, Form & Frys delivers both standardized machinery and customized solutions tailored to specific production requirements. Since 2025, Form & Frys has been part of Rademaker, strengthening the company’s international reach and creating a strong platform for continued development and growth. Learn more about this here: https://www.formfrys.dk/

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure investments? If so, come and join Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI), a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) subsidiary company exclusively dedicated to developing energy hubs globally. We are currently looking for a Director to join our team.

_**Team

**Energy hubs will be the next generation of energy infrastructure assets. They will be critical in enabling cost-efficient deployment of large-scale renewable energy to achieve energy security and to reach ambitious global decarbonization targets, while maintaining cost competitiveness of the energy system. Energy islands, or energy hubs, are multifunctional energy infrastructure projects, involving large-scale renewable energy production integrated with conversion technologies to deliver electrons and molecules to demand centers. Copenhagen Energy Islands (CEI) is a company dedicated to originating and developing these projects.

You will be working closely together with an experienced team in a high paced, dynamic environment. We bring experts together with backgrounds in commercial, regulatory, development, legal, consulting and financial careers, to name a few.

We are a strong, social, and multi-national team with a passion for making a difference. Our collective character can be described as creative, dedicated, resourceful and humble. We are excited to work on something that is complex and will enable a step-change for the renewable industry.

**Role

**As a Director you will supervise several teams that work on opportunities in a number of markets. You will oversee the activities in technical, commercial, stakeholder and financial workstreams; and you will drive our external relationships with partners, advisors, and (non-)governmental organizations.

Your responsibilities will be to:

• Maximize the CEI investment value of the energy hub opportunities you work on

• Coordinate development activities with workstream managers that form part of the project development team

• Build and mature the investment cases for the CEI project you work on

• Own the project financial model and ensure that the model is maintained and used consistently across the projects

• Be the CEI focal point for our (joint venture) partners

• Manage the processes related to joint ventures, fund raising, divestitures; including negotiation of agreements and transaction documents

• Develop insights and high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders

• Advise CEI leadership team regarding general corporate matters such as portfolio management and resource allocation considerations

• Support CEI fundraise activities, including managing certain workstreams

• Play an active role in origination of new project opportunities and develop in-depth understanding of target markets

• You will help to manage, train and develop the Managers, Associates and Analysts, and will contribute to the positive, professional and collegiate working environment

• Participate in our activities to grow the team, such as interviewing and ranking candidates.

**You

**The work environment at CEI is lean, stimulating and demanding, within a global context. We are therefore looking for a self-starting, collaborative, and high-performance professional with an entrepreneurial drive. You have 15+ years of relevant experience from project development or infrastructure investment organizations.

Moreover, you have a background in offshore wind, hydrogen, Oil & Gas or other energy development and track record in bringing complex investments successfully to Final Investment Decision.

Key qualifications include:

• Knowledge of regulatory environment in the energy sector, and familiar with stakeholder engagement practices to shape desired outcomes

• Corporate Development and M&A knowledge

• Experience in commercial negotiations

• Ability to contribute to the overarching logic of business case when dealing with senior leadership and to step into the detail when discussing project specific aspects

• Experience in rapidly growing teams and businesses as well as exposure to critical governance structures and processes in an international environment is preferable

• Team player with the confidence to exercise judgement appropriately, engaging with colleagues at all levels of seniority

• Advanced communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work well under pressure and take on responsibility

• You are proactive, think ahead and stay hands-on.

It is the expectation that frequent presence in Copenhagen is necessary for success.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

**Building value that matters

**Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) is a global fund manager and leading investor in energy infrastructure. CIP builds value that matters by developing and constructing critical infrastructure projects that shape the future of energy.

Through its funds, CIP invests in power generation (solar and wind), energy storage, transmission and distribution, advanced bioenergy, low-carbon fuels and carbon capture.

With 15 funds currently under management, CIP is trusted by over 200 of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutions, having raised EUR ~43 billion to date.

CIP has projects in more than 30 countries, with presence on the ground through a network of +2,300 professionals with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Amsterdam, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul, and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

DPM GE Business support

Drug Product Manufacturing IO

Global Manufacturing & Supply

**Your impact begins here

**As Finance Partner, you will turn financial insight into better decisions across Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) in Gentofte. You will partner with directors and the management group on planning, performance and strategy deployment. You will bring transparency to the numbers, strengthen finance processes and help the site keep unit cost low, both now and in the long term. Your analysis will help production teams make clear, well-founded choices.

**What You'll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, International Business or similar.

• 3–4 years of experience in finance partnering and controlling, such as financial planning and analysis, business controlling or auditing.

• Experience navigating complex organisational structures in a large company, with excellent stakeholder engagement skills and the ability to drive agendas independently.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to see the big picture and focus on detail when needed.

• High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

• Full professional proficiency in English.

You are driven by analyzing data and solving financial challenges. You take responsibility whatever the complexity, and you keep a strong focus on quality and structure. You build strong relationships at all levels and explain complex issues clearly.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience in pharmaceutical production or production economy.

• Knowledge of SAP or another major ERP system.

• Business intelligence (BI) skills.

**What You'll Do

**You will work with the management group on financial planning and analysis, performance management and business strategy deployment. You will:

• Act as finance partner to key stakeholders, including directors, at the DPM site in Gentofte.

• Drive financial processes, including budget, rolling estimate and month-end reporting.

• Give financial guidance to the organization and help develop the processes and tools that improve financial transparency.

• Analyze data and create insights that support management decisions, such as business cases and strategic finance analysis.

• Prepare management presentations, along with ad hoc analyses and tasks.

• Work with the management team and the finance community to continuously improve finance processes and bridge finance and the business across DPM Gentofte.

**Who You'll Work With

**In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain, from drug and device development to marketed Novo products. They scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them. More than 30,000 colleagues around the world share this responsibility.

You will join the Business Support department at DPM Site Gentofte, which enables operational success through close collaboration and strong cross-functional partnerships. You will be part of the Finance, Investment and Procurement team. It manages all finance partnering and procurement activities at the site. This includes driving process excellence, allocating resources well, and delivering insights and actions based on available data.

You will join a diverse team of 8–10 colleagues with different levels of business experience. Together, you will spot gaps and propose high-quality improvements to processes and the organisation. Your closest partners will be the management group and directors at DPM Gentofte, together with the wider finance community.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an ambitious team that aims to deliver the best possible service to the production departments. You will get plenty of sparring and development feedback. You will have room to take ownership, build your skills and grow your impact. The team also makes sure to have fun while it drives the business forward.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Working at Novo Nordisk

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn financial insight into progress for the production teams in Gentofte, apply by 22 November 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about your motivation to apply in your CV.

Please apply in English and refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing. We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants. Note that we use screening questions as part of the application process for this position; however, all CVs are reviewed by a recruiter. We encourage you to answer these carefully, as they help us assess your expectations, experience and qualifications.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

**The Opportunity

**Veo's security surface is unusual. We train models on-premise on dedicated GPU infrastructure, run the product across AWS and GCP, and operate a fleet of tens of thousands of cameras deployed at clubs and venues worldwide. That is a scope most SaaS security engineers never touch: physical devices in the field, heavy on-prem compute, and multi-cloud production, all in one role.

We are forming a Security Enablement Team that makes it easier for every engineering and IT team at Veo to build, ship, and operate secure systems. As the most senior engineer on the team, you will own the technical direction of the platform security, identity, and network security slice, partnering with the teams that own these systems so security is built in from the start. As an enablement function, the team does not run these systems day to day. We build the paved roads, tooling, and patterns that let the owning teams operate securely by default.

You will join during a pivotal moment. We are standing the team up, defining what good looks like across platform security, identity, and network security, and rolling out the first paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, CVE response, CI/CD identity, and a unified internal network across our datacenters (GCP, AWS) and offices (Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen). You'll have direct impact on how 100+ engineers write, review and ship secure systems.

**What You Will Do

**You will join a focused platform security team and operate as its most senior engineer. Everything below follows the same pattern. We design the paved road, prove it works, and hand it to the team that will own it. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities, and we expect this role to set the bar.

• Design and build the paved roads for image scanning, SBOM generation, and CVE response, running inside the pipelines teams already use, with findings routed to the owners who can fix them under tracked SLAs

• Lead the design, reviews, and tooling for a unified internal network and VPN across GCP, AWS, and our Miami, Berlin, and Copenhagen offices, while the team that owns the network keeps running it

• Work with the auth service maintainers on identity and access, including MFA rollouts, removal of shared accounts, and cleanup of long-lived tokens, so the patterns stay theirs to own

• Make workload identity the paved road for CI/CD, using OIDC between GitHub Actions and AWS or GCP, packaged so teams can migrate themselves

• Build audit logging as a shared capability that teams plug into rather than reinvent

• Turn GRC controls into technical implementations, with evidence pipelines that produce auditable output without manual follow-up

• Own the contracting cycle for external penetration tests and build the intake, classification, and tracking system that routes findings to named owners, while the owning teams remediate

• Hand each capability off cleanly, with a runbook, a named owner, and an escalation path, and run office hours where product and platform teams can get a security review or a paved-road question answered

• Mentor the rest of the team and raise the security bar across Builders

As the team matures, you will help shape our multi-environment network architecture, our identity and access patterns, and the long-term security posture of the product.

**What You Could Bring

**This is a deliberately merged platform security and identity role. You do not need to be world class at both. You likely have several years of production infrastructure and security experience behind you, and you are deep and credible in one of these areas and ready to grow into the other.

That depth tends to show up in several of the following:

• Platform security: you have run vulnerability scanning, CVE management, and image scanning at scale, and you know the operational reality of getting CVEs fixed, beyond standing up the tooling

Working at Novo

As Product Development Engineer Specialist, you will shape how primary packaging and device engineering come together to create reliable products for people who depend on them. What you’ll bring

This role needs deep expertise in regulated product development and the credibility to align colleagues around shared technical decisions. You will bring:

• A degree in engineering or science.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

• Extensive experience in medical device or other regulated product development, with direct experience of injection devices and/or pre-filled syringes.

• Practical command of the design-control lifecycle: requirements, design inputs and outputs, traceability, verification and validation, design reviews, transfer and design changes.

• Hands-on product risk management experience across development, manufacturing, transportation and use.

jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

Ready to bring together microbial science, GMP manufacturing and project responsibility in a senior role where your work directly supports the development of future medicines? Join our Microbial Cell Bank team, where every drug substance begins - we manufacture and maintain the cell banks that are the starting point for drug substance production all over the world. Working cross-functionally across projects, you will combine your scientific expertise with GMP responsibility and help drive continuous improvement of our Cell Bank operation. Ready to take the lead where every medicine begins? Apply today!

**What you’ll do

**As a Senior Scientist in the Microbial Cell Bank, you will take a leading professional role in activities related to the production and lifecycle management of our cell banks. You will take ownership of complex tasks and projects, working closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, QA, QC and project teams. With your experience, you will help navigate cross-functional processes, identify solutions and contribute to developing both our processes and ways of working. Depending on your experience and interests, the role provides an opportunity to build deeper expertise and potentially develop towards a specialist position.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Planning and supporting GMP manufacture of microbial Master Cell Banks (MCBs) and Working Cell Banks (WCBs).

• Taking project responsibility for cell bank projects from incoming Initial Cell Clone (ICC) through production, characterisation, release and lifecycle activities.

• Preparing and maintaining specifications, production documentation and other GMP documentation.

• Coordinating activities and solving issues across QA, QC, project teams and other key stakeholders.

• Handling deviations and change requests and driving systematic problem solving.

• Supporting regulatory activities, audits, inspections and responses to Health Authority questions.

• Driving continuous improvements to cell bank processes and ways of working.

• Contributing to the continued digitalisation of our Cell Bank operation and exploring how new technologies, including AI, can support smarter and more efficient ways of working.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this role, we imagine that you hold a relevant master’s degree within biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry or a related scientific field. You also have:

• a solid background from the pharmaceutical industry and a strong understanding of GMP.

• hands-on skills in microbial cultivation and knowledge of microbiology, molecular biology, cellular biology and analytical science.

• a proven ability to navigate a complex organisation and work across functions.

• a strong quality mindset combined with an analytical and pragmatic approach to problem solving.

• an interest in digitalisation and new technology. Experience with AI is an advantage, but curiosity and motivation to explore how AI can improve our work are equally important.

On a personal level, you are collaborative, curious and motivated by taking professional and independent ownership of activities and projects involving multiple stakeholders. You enjoy sharing your knowledge and contributing to the development of others while continuously strengthening your own expertise. You communicate effectively across functions and organisational levels and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when you see opportunities to improve.

Who you’ll work with

CMC Development turns promising molecules into approved products in close collaboration with colleagues across Research & Development and Global Manufacturing & Supply.

Cell Banks are at the starting point of drug substance production and play an important role in bringing new medicines through CMC Drug Development. We are a team of approximately 16 scientists and laboratory technicians working with microbial cell banks in Bagsværd and mammalian cell banks in Hillerød, with an ambition to collaborate closely and share knowledge across the two locations.

We have a strong focus on quality, collaboration and delivering for our projects. At the same time, we are ambitious about developing the Cell Bank area and continuously improving our processes, facilities and digital ways of working. We value an open and collaborative environment where we help each other, share knowledge and believe that having fun at work is an important part of being a strong team.

What you can expect here

You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued, and your contribution can shape decisions across markets. You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership. You will be encouraged to make your voice heard, learn from colleagues and contribute to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases. We foster a collaborative culture where we care for one another, value initiative, and empower you to drive projects forward while growing professionally.

**What we offer

**Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives and other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

jobs.description:
Are you motivated by the opportunity to deepen your leadership, commercial and advisory impact while contributing to sustainable growth in the operational transformation area? As Associate Partner and Competence Team Lead for Valcon’s Operational Transformation team, you will play a key role in developing our people, strengthening client partnerships and evolving our capabilities. And you will be instrumental in growing the area considerably in the future matching Valcon’s growth ambitions.

Role and profile

The job is located at the intersection between client delivery, team leadership, commercial work and service offering development.

You will lead a team of approximately 12 consultants and help shape the continued development of our Operational Transformation offerings, focused on Process Redesign and Process Automation, including agentic automation. You are expected to support the further integration of AI, data and technological capabilities into the services based on a clear understanding of our clients’ business needs and strategic ambitions. The ideal candidate brings deep experience and insight from both operations’ excellence and business process redesign as well as technology-driven business change and automation.

You will also act as a trusted advisor to clients, and contribute to Valcon’s growth by being commercial active, building trusted client relationships and lead projects that deliver sustainable results.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these four competence areas:

• Team leadership: Guide, inspire and develop a talented team of consultants, fostering an inclusive environment where people can thrive, collaborate effectively and deliver meaningful results together

• Commercial growth: Strengthen Valcon’s position as a trusted advisor by building long-term client partnerships and creating sustainable growth opportunities together with clients

• Client engagement: Manage and deliver complex projects with high-quality standards from initial mobilization to final delivery and further expansions

• Service development leadership: Develop internal capabilities and strengthen methodologies with AI, data, and technology as key enablers of business transformation

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility. The ability to balance time between all four areas is key, as they are equally important for success in this role.

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• People skills: Build and nurture existing relationships and teams through empathy, engagement and effective communication with clear direction

• Business and digital acumen: Think analytically and strategically with a pragmatic approach to execution. View AI, data and digital technology as integral elements of modern business development

• Subject-matter-expertise: Business process redesign, improvement and automation

• Education: Speak and write English fluently and professionally, with Danish being a plus. Completed relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience. Further education is a plus

Organisation and reporting

You will be the direct people manager of the Operational Transformation team of consultants (excluding Associate Partners and Partners) or managing their people managers. The role reports to a Partner from either one of our Commercial Sectors or our Head of Consulting.

Location and travel

The role is based at Valcon’s offices in central Copenhagen or Århus, Denmark. You can expect travel in connection with client meetings and project work, primarily within the Nordic region.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape – fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex transformation projects in the business and technological space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. Deadline for applications is Monday December 7, but we do review applications on an ongoing basis.
